note: Summary of the per-check evidence records referenced by the acceptance ledgers; raw logs/screenshots stay in the git-ignored verification/ tree (hashes listed).

actions: Launch 'UI4ME Desktop Workspace' and 'UI4ME Host Reference' from Plasma Kickoff (Super, type name, Enter)
N01.expected: Hosted app identity, icon and single taskbar entry
N01.observed: KWin desktopFileName/resourceClass org.ui4me.RendererReference and org.ui4me.HostReference; window icon set; one 'U' taskbar entry

actions: Second Kickoff launch while the app runs
N02.expected: Forwarded to the running instance; one backend
N02.observed: Second systemd unit started and exited; hosts/backends unchanged (one backend), one window

actions: Probe second window: resize, maximize, unmaximize, fullscreen, minimize, restore, native close (async before_close)
N03.expected: Window operations honoured; asynchronous close decision
N03.observed: All operations reflected in KWin geometry/state; close accepted by backend

actions: Probe Ctrl+C -> GTK3 reader; GTK3 owner -> probe Ctrl+V with Unicode; 2.2 MB clipboard paste
Renderer Name Ctrl+C -> GTK3; GTK3 -> Notes Ctrl+V
N04.expected: Bidirectional Unicode clipboard with another app; oversized text rejected
N04.observed: GTK3 saw text/plain;charset=utf-8 offers and exact text both ways; 2.2 MB paste left text unchanged (1 MiB bound). User clipboard (image/png) saved and restored around the tests

actions: Probe F3/F4/F5 then Escape; F3 select file; F4 save typed name; F7 from second window; parent close with dialog open; Ctrl+Q with folder dialog open
N05.expected: Portal dialogs parented, cancellable, races resolved
N05.observed: Open/save dialogs transient for the probe window and modal; cancel/select/save results correct; F7 cancellation; parent close -32004 and dialog gone; quit closed the dialog and exited 0
limitations: KDE folder chooser (xdg-desktop-portal-kde) is not parented to the requesting window (known 0.1 limitation)

actions: fcitx5 5.1.12 (pinyin + keyboard-us-intl, temporary) in probe editor: preedit, commit, Escape cancel, selection replacement, dead key
N06.expected: Real IME composition with correct caret/candidates
N06.observed: Preedit shown inline, candidates at caret, commit/cancel/replace correct; dead key composes é without an IME/redraw loop
limitations: The probe's built-in font has limited CJK glyph coverage (renders boxes); the HTML renderer uses system fallback

actions: AT-SPI dump of probe; Tab focus; AT-SPI grab_focus Paste; do_action Copy
N07.expected: Accessible tree, focus and actions via native accessibility
N07.observed: Tree with entry/buttons; Tab focus Copy/Paste/Open file; grab_focus and Copy action worked (clipboard updated)

actions: kscreen-doctor HDMI-A-1 scale 1 -> 1.5 -> 1 with the renderer app open
N08.expected: Surface recreation, correct pointer/IME geometry, display restored
N08.observed: Crisp 1.5x render; clicks hit Name/Notes; pinyin candidate anchored at caret; restored 2048x1080 scale 1
limitations: AT-SPI extents are reported in device pixels at fractional scale (AccessKit root transform)

actions: Native fault fixtures freeze-close/freeze-quit/crash-after-ready; freeze-quit --duration 0 with typing and Ctrl+Shift+Q; renderer --crash-after-ready failure UI Quit
N09.expected: Host-local painting/input and failure UI usable while backend frozen/crashed
N09.observed: Fixtures PASS; typing worked while quit decision withheld; Ctrl+Shift+Q exited; failure surface 'Application backend stopped' with working Quit

actions: run_faults managed-tree (normal quit) and managed-tree --kill-host with systemd user-service containment
N10.expected: Child and grandchild cleaned up after quit and after host SIGKILL
N10.observed: Both reports PASS, no surviving descendants

actions: run_example --external-target file, F8 (portal OpenURI, KDE chooser -> Kate), then Ctrl+Q; repeat with host SIGKILL
N11.observed: Kate ran in xdg-desktop-portal.service cgroup, alive after orderly quit and after SIGKILL; test Kate windows closed afterwards

actions: Installed probe (~/.local/share/ui4me-reference) and renderer app launched from Kickoff
N12.observed: exe ~/.cargo/bin/ui4me-host, cwd $HOME, backend from install dir, no developer env vars

actions: Drag a Unicode-named file from a new Dolphin window and Unicode text from KWrite into the probe
N13.observed: dropped_files with .../dnd src/drag-ž.txt and dropped_text 'Dragged text: Příliš žluťoučký 日本語'

actions: Nested kwin_wayland realm (socket ui4me-nested); launch installed app in main and nested realm; second launch in each
N14.expected: Separate instance per desktop realm; forwarding stays within the realm
N14.observed: Two backends (WAYLAND_DISPLAY wayland-0 and ui4me-nested); second launches did not add backends; cleaned up

actions: tools/measure_resources.py (probe) --startup-runs 5 --idle 30 --cycles 400 --sample-every 50 on installed release
N15.expected: Startup, idle CPU, memory and window cycles measured
N15.observed: See probe-measurements.json: startup-to-ready median 127 ms; idle host CPU 0.22%; window-cycle growth 3.27 KiB/cycle (known zbus per-window residue)

actions: Launch installed app from Kickoff; screenshot; inspect process
R01.expected: Local HTML/CSS/font/PNG/SVG render natively; no browser/server/network
R01.observed: Full styled document in native window; assets from the install dir; no browser/HTTP processes
limitations: CJK/emoji glyphs come from installed system fallback fonts; emoji render monochrome

actions: Real input: Name '<tag> & value', select High, uncheck flag, Work radio, estimate, progress, Add row; palette toggled
R02.expected: Literal text, one transaction per row, live preview, state reflected
R02.observed: Row 03 '<tag> & value'/High/No; count/status updated together; light/dark palettes

actions: GTK3 clipboard both ways; fcitx5 pinyin in textarea and input (preedit, commit, emoji candidate, cancel, selection replacement, focus change); us-intl dead keys; CPU with pending dead key
R03.expected: Real IME and cross-app clipboard with correct caret/selection
R03.observed: All values as expected; pending dead key no longer raises CPU (loop fixed)

actions: Tab order; Space/Enter on Add row; Enter in Name (implicit submission); empty required Name; drag selection, cut, undo/redo; wheel over nested table
R04.expected: Keyboard navigation, default actions, submission local, hit testing, scrolling
R04.observed: DOM-order focus; one row per activation; implicit submission adds row; validation blocks empty Name and focuses it; undo/redo exact

actions: AT-SPI tree; EditableText.set_text_contents; Text.set_selection; checkbox action; slider Value; Add row action; Orca 48.1 keyboard journey with speech log
R05.expected: Roles/names/states/values, actions reach document and backend, real screen-reader speech
R05.observed: 100-node tree; all actions applied; Orca spoke labels/roles/values/states and announced the status live region after Add row
limitations: Combobox current value is not exposed over AT-SPI by the AccessKit 0.21 Linux adapter: Orca says 'Priority combo box Priority' (value available on Windows/UIA)

actions: Second document: independent values, maximize/minimize/restore/resize, native and HTML close, reopen; main 700 px responsive layout; scale 1.5 and back
R06.expected: Independent documents, correct geometry/focus at all sizes and scales
R06.observed: All behaved as expected; AT-SPI frames removed on close

actions: cargo test asset/renderer/document resource policy tests (314 listed, all ok)
Copy of installed app with missing image and corrupt font: CPU render diagnostics, native run, 10 rapid second-window cycles
R07.expected: Bounded, diagnosed resource failures without hang
R07.observed: FILE_NOT_FOUND and DECODE_FAILED diagnostics, no pending work; app usable; no host errors

actions: Choose a file: Escape, Unicode selection; Attachment file input; HTML dialog (Tab trap, backdrop, Escape, Close) and popover; native close of parent with picker open
R08.expected: Parented cancellable picker, overlays and focus restoration
R08.observed: Portal dialog transient for main window and modal; results correct; focus restored; parent close removed dialog and exited 0

actions: --updates 0.25: main fully covered ~47 s then minimized ~48 s while editing second window; restore; covered Ctrl+Shift+Q
--hold-callback: edit, AT-SPI action, resize, native close; Ctrl+Shift+Q
--crash-after-ready 3: failure UI Quit; native fault fixtures
R09.expected: Updates continue, host stays responsive, latest state shown, emergency quit works
R09.observed: Updates 40->520 continuously; second window edits applied; restored status current; all exits clean

actions: measure_resources.py --renderer --startup-runs 5 --idle 30 --cycles 400 --dom-cycles 800 --sample-every 50 on installed release; attribution runs with AT-SPI bus disabled/enabled
R10.observed: Startup-to-ready median 527 ms (first frame ~41 ms after host start); idle host CPU 0.23%; combined idle PSS 60.1 MB; DOM churn flat (0.02 KiB/cycle); window cycles 18.6 KiB/cycle with AT-SPI enabled, plateau without it (attributed to the AT-SPI/zbus per-object residue, probe 3.27 KiB/cycle)
limitations: Window-cycle growth with an active AT-SPI bus scales with accessible node count (~20 KiB per closed 100-node document window)

actions: tools/install.py --example-dir ~/.local/share/ui4me-renderer-reference; create_launcher; launch from Kickoff; second launch; Quit
R11.expected: Installed app outside checkout via desktop menu
R11.observed: Launcher, identity, icon, assets, forwarding and shutdown as expected

actions: tools/browser_reference.py --host installed (Playwright 1.65.1, Chromium headless shell 158.0.8127.18)
R12.expected: All four fixtures within predeclared tolerances, images reviewed
R12.observed: B01 MAE 0.044, B02 identical, B03 MAE 0.661 (antialiasing only), B04 MAE 0.036

common.platform: Debian GNU/Linux 13, kernel 6.12.116, KDE Plasma 6.3 KWin native Wayland (wayland-0), HDMI-A-1 2048x1080 scale 1, user toor (not elevated)

tested_host.build: python3 tools/install.py --jobs 2 --example-dir ~/.local/share/ui4me-renderer-reference (cargo install --locked, release, thin LTO)

source.observation_carry_forward: Observations were made on milestone m5 (source fd7fdfcb) with the same executable: the m6 rebuild produced the byte-identical binary 81a503fd... because the only change (vendored winit-win32 patch) is Windows-only code; assets and Python files are unchanged.

common.input: Real kernel input via uinput (python3-evdev) into KWin; window activation via KWin scripting; observation via AT-SPI, journald and spectacle screenshots
